item.title: ATOM PARTNERS LIMITED: Junior Crypto Trader (Remote)
item.description:
Headquarters: ATOM PARTNERS LIMITED
URL: https://atomsmiths.com

Application link: https://atomsmiths.com/work/weworkremotely

ATOM Partners is an international company focused on digital asset markets, trading technologies, and data-driven market research. We work with modern analytical tools and help aspiring professionals build practical knowledge of cryptocurrency trading in a structured environment.

We are currently looking for a Junior Crypto Trader to join our growing remote team. This opportunity is designed for motivated individuals who are interested in financial markets, cryptocurrency, and analytical thinking. Previous professional trading experience is not required — we provide comprehensive training and continuous guidance throughout the onboarding process.

What You'll Do

  • Execute trades according to established trading strategies and internal guidelines.
  • Monitor cryptocurrency markets and identify potential trading opportunities.
  • Analyze charts, technical indicators, and market trends.
  • Follow market news and evaluate its potential impact on digital assets.
  • Maintain trading discipline and apply risk management principles.
  • Record and review your trading performance.
  • Use professional trading software and market analysis tools.
  • Continuously improve your market knowledge and trading skills.

What We're Looking For

  • Interest in cryptocurrency, trading, or financial markets.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to stay focused and make decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to learn and develop professionally.
  • Good written and spoken English.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote position with flexible working hours.
  • Comprehensive onboarding program provided by the company.
  • Hands-on experience with professional trading platforms.
  • Access to market analytics, educational resources, and trading tools.
  • Ongoing mentorship from experienced market professionals.
  • Clear development path with opportunities for increased responsibility.
  • Performance-based compensation.

Benefits

  • Remote work from anywhere.
  • Flexible schedule.
  • Structured training program.
  • Career development opportunities.
  • Continuous mentorship.
  • International team.
  • Modern analytical tools.

Recruitment Process

  • Step 1: Initial phone conversation with one of our recruiters.
  • Step 2: Online interview to discuss your background, motivation, and career goals.
  • Step 3: Introductory training session with a trading mentor before joining the team.

Application link: https://atomsmiths.com/work/weworkremotely

item.title: Tailscale: Brand Designer
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote (United States)

Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Tailscale is looking for an experienced Brand Designer to help bring our brand to life across every customer touchpoint. You'll create thoughtful, high-quality creative that helps people understand our products, builds trust with technical audiences, and supports some of our most important marketing initiatives.

This role reports to the Team Lead and partners closely with Brand, Growth, Web, Content, Product Marketing, and Developer Relations. You'll own projects from concept through execution, contribute to the evolution of our design systems, and help us scale creative output without sacrificing quality.

We're looking for someone who cares deeply about craft, thrives in collaborative environments but is able to work autonomously while requiring minimal direction, and enjoys solving complex communication problems through thoughtful design.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own brand design projects from creative brief through final delivery with limited guidance
  • Design high-quality creative assets across web, campaigns, events, social media, presentations, product marketing, and internal communications
  • Apply and thoughtfully extend Tailscale's visual identity across new formats and channels
  • Create reusable templates, design systems, and creative processes that improve consistency and efficiency
  • Partner closely with Growth, Web, Product Marketing, Content, and Developer Relations to deliver cohesive customer experiences
  • Present design concepts and rationale to stakeholders and thoughtfully incorporate feedback
  • Balance multiple projects while consistently delivering polished, production-ready work
  • Contribute ideas that improve the quality, scalability, and effectiveness of our creative work

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional experience in brand, marketing, or visual design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional design foundations: color theory, accessibility, typography, layout, and storytelling
  • Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud 
  • Experience designing for digital marketing, websites, campaigns, and brand systems
  • Strong understanding of production-ready design across digital and print
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities with minimal oversight
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with marketers, writers, developers, and other designers
  • Strong attention to detail with a high bar for quality and consistency
  • Comfortable giving and receiving constructive design feedback
  • Actively seeks opportunities to refine processes, improve project organization, and make collaboration more effective through thoughtful recommendations.
  • Curious by nature, with a desire to learn about the technical world of networking.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing for B2B SaaS or developer-focused products
  • Familiarity with design systems and component libraries
  • Motion design or animation experience
  • Illustration or icon design experience
  • Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and web design constraints
  • Experience supporting experimentation, conversion optimization, or growth marketing initiatives
  • Experience working in fast-paced startup or scale-up environments
  • Experience art-directing or mentoring junior designers

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range
$117,750—$153,000 USD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. 
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! 
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own. 
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/tailscale-brand-designer-1

item.title: Databricks: Deployment Strategist
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote - India

About the Team

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Role Description

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

The impact you will have

  • C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
  • End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
  • Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
  • Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
  • Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for

  • Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
  • Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
  • Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
  • Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
  • Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Compliance

If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/databricks-deployment-strategist

item.title: Databricks: Delivery Solutions Architect - Startups & Emerging Enterprise
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote - California; Remote - Colorado; Remote - Illinois; Remote - Massachusetts; Remote - New York; Remote - Oregon; Remote - Texas; Remote - Washington

At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilizing the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey. You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform with Startup and Emerging Enterprise customers. You will also help ensure customer success by helping our most complex customers maximize the value they get out of our platform and their return on investment.

This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases by leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestrating other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon. It is technical in the sense that you will serve as the post-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. This requires you to use your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate at all levels within an organization. You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization. 

The impact you will have:

  • Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritized customers
  • Lead the post-technical-win account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
  • Be the accountable technical leader for specific use cases and customers across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, go-live, and healthy consumption of the workloads the customer has chosen to run on Databricks
  • Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, often spanning multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
  • Leverage Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services, and Support resources, and escalate to subject matter experts when work falls beyond your scope or expertise
  • Create, own, and execute a point of view on how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
  • Partner with Databricks Product and Engineering teams on new product innovations, private previews, and upgrades
  • Develop an execution plan spanning all customer-facing technical roles and teams across the following work streams:
    • Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production
    • Enablement / user growth plan
    • Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision)
    • Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning & optimization)
    • Executive and operational governance
  • Provide internal and external updates to your Technical GM — KPI reporting on usage and customer health, covering investment status, key risks, product adoption, and use case progression

What we look for:

  • 5+ years of experience accountable for technical project / program delivery in Data and AI, with the ability to contribute to technical debate and design choices alongside customers
  • Programming experience in Python, SQL or Scala 
  • Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role
  • Understanding of solution architecture for distributed data systems
  • Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverable
  • Technical program or project management, including accountability for accounts, stakeholders, and resources
  • Experience resolving complex, high-stakes escalations with senior customer executives
  • Experience conducting open-ended discovery workshops, creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis, and managing delivery of complex programs/projects
  • Track record of overachievement against quota, goals, or similar objective targets
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • Can travel up to 30% when needed



 

Pay Range Transparency

Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles.  Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. item.title: Lattice: Lead Product Manager
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote - Canada

What You Will Do

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the future of the Lattice MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and the integrations that power Lattice AI. This is the connective layer that lets customers use Lattice performance data inside the AI tools they already work in (Claude, ChatGPT, Glean, Microsoft Copilot, and Slack), and that brings third-party productivity data (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Linear, Zoom, Asana) into Lattice. As AI becomes the center of gravity for how companies work, this surface is how Lattice stays connected, interoperable, and indispensable. You’ll join a fully staffed engineering team ready to execute, and together you’ll make ecosystem interoperability a reason customers choose and stay with Lattice. 

If you enjoy solving complex problems, shaping platform strategy, and working with great internal and external partners, you’ll love the impact you can have here. As a Lead Product Manager for MCP & AI Ecosystem, you will:

  • Own the MCP and AI ecosystem strategy. Not only decide what features and integrations to pursue, but what MCP and AI mean to Lattice and our customers. Become a thought leader on how AI should shape HR for the better.
  • Ship integrations that create leverage. Deliver new MCP tools, resources, and third-party connectors that expand what admins, managers, and executives can do with Lattice data in the flow of work.
  • Build durable foundations, like authentication, agentic execution frameworks, and evals that make future integrations faster, more scalable, and easier to adopt and maintain.
  • Be a technical thought partner to Engineering. Help shape technical direction on MCP tool design and third party integration infrastructure, translating complex constraints into clear product decisions.
  • Drive go-to-market with partners. Partner with Partnerships, Product Marketing, to launch integrations that deliver measurable customer and ecosystem impact.
  • Own outcomes. Influence and own key results across integration and MCP adoption, reliability, activation, and ecosystem growth.

What You Will Bring to the Table

We’re looking for a seasoned product manager with the technical depth and strategic instincts to shape Lattice’s next generation of integrations and APIs. You’ll be a great fit if you have a combination of:

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with meaningful ownership of integrations, platform, or ecosystem surfaces (built end-to-end, not just configured).
  • Direct experience building technical integrations in a multi-party ecosystem — for example ad technology / marketing technology, marketplaces, developer platforms, payments, data connectivity, or similar — where partnership strategy shaped what you built.
  • Strong technical fluency: comfortable with third-party integration patterns, data sync and field mapping, webhooks, and auth/OAuth; you can hold a credible architecture conversation with engineers and partner CTOs.
  • A track record of shipping scalable, reliable integrations in partnership with engineering, and of standing up partner or marketplace launches with go-to-market teams.
  • Evidence of turning a platform or ecosystem into a competitive advantage — a reason customers chose your product, not just a checkbox.
  • Clear, confident communication that brings internal teams and external partners into alignment.
  • A bias for action and the ability to create structure in an ambiguous, fast-moving space. 

Bonus:

  • Exposure to AI ecosystems, MCP, AI agents, or LLM tooling (helpful, not required).
  • Experience in multi-product B2B SaaS, or with HR/people-data or other sensitive-data workflows.

If you have strong experience with integrations, APIs, or platform products, even if you don’t meet every preferred qualification, we encourage you to apply. We’re looking for strong product thinkers with deep technical fluency, not perfect resumes.

Location Requirement:
This role is open to candidates located in British Columbia or Ontario, Canada. At this time, we are only able to hire employees residing in these provinces.

__

The estimated annual cash salary for this role is CAD $135,000 - $180,000. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Lattice’s applicable plans.

Benefits: Lattice offers eligible Canada-based employees comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability coverage; mental health and wellness support; emergency weather support; 16 weeks of paid parental leave; flexible time off, 13 company holidays, and 3 recharge days; a monthly remote-work stipend and one-time home-office setup stipend; an RRSP contribution match of up to 3% of gross pay (maximum $2,500 CAD annually); and a $500 CAD annual Learning & Development reimbursement. Benefits are subject to applicable eligibility requirements.

*Note on Pay Transparency:

Lattice provides an estimate of the compensation for roles that may be hired as required by state regulations. Compensation may vary based on (a) location, as Lattice factors in specific location when benchmarking compensation for most roles; (b) individual candidate skills and qualifications; and (c) individual candidate experience.

Additionally, Lattice leverages current market data to determine compensation, so posted compensation figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. item.title: Lattice: Ecosystem Marketing Lead
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

This role owns how Lattice turns its partner and integration ecosystem into a GTM advantage. It goes beyond traditional HR partnerships: the goal is to build relationships and joint go-to-market motions with the broader AI and work-tech ecosystem, including future-of-work platforms like OpenAI, Anthropic, Slack, and other tools Lattice integrates with, so Lattice reaches managers and functional leaders, not just HR buyers.

What You Will Do

  • Own the partner-facing GTM strategy and packaging for Lattice’s ecosystem partnerships and integrations.
  • Partner closely with Product and Integrations teams on what Lattice builds, while owning how partner-enabled capabilities are positioned and brought to market.
  • Develop joint launches, campaigns, events, content, customer stories, and executive programs with strategic partners.
  • Translate partner-enabled capabilities into clear customer value, use cases, messaging, and differentiated positioning.
  • Build repeatable partner marketing motions across co-marketing, field activation, account opportunities, customer advocacy, and sales enablement.
  • Work with Sales and Field Marketing to activate partners through events, regional programs, account-based opportunities, and customer-facing moments.
  • Identify and prioritize partners that can create distribution, credibility, pipeline, and category leadership, in addition to integration value.
  • Expand Lattice’s reach into managers, functional leaders, and broader business stakeholders through strategic ecosystem programs.
  • Own partner-facing launch timing, marketplace distribution opportunities, and Lattice’s presence in relevant third-party marketplaces.
  • Represent Lattice at strategic partner events, virtually and in person, and lead event-based commercial activation alongside partners.
  • Educate partners on Lattice’s integration capabilities, limitations, and dependencies in collaboration with Product Marketing, Product, and Engineering.
  • Establish clear goals and measurement for partner marketing programs, using results to improve future investments and partner plans.

What You Will Bring to the Table

  • 5+ years of experience in partner marketing, ecosystem marketing, alliances, field marketing, or a related B2B SaaS go-to-market role.
  • Experience developing and executing joint go-to-market programs with technology partners, including campaigns, events, content, launches, and sales activation.
  • Ability to translate technical products, integrations, and platform capabilities into relevant customer stories and commercial programs.
  • Experience partnering effectively with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, and Field Marketing teams.
  • A track record of managing multiple cross-functional and external stakeholder relationships, setting priorities, and driving programs from concept through execution.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • A practical, metrics-oriented approach to evaluating program performance, partner value, and future investment.
